description:
Use this when you need a deterministic France France national legal public holidays result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when alsace-Moselle, overseas territories, employer, sector, school, bank, exchange and regional calendars are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: France: Bastille Day.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-07-14"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/france-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/france-working-day.md
name: check_fr_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Article L3133-1 national legal list; May 1 has special mandatory-rest protection while other holidays can be worked under applicable collective/employer rules

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: No national substitute-day closure is inferred; Alsace-Moselle and local/sector rules require separate authority evidence

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: France Working Day
